title: Chunk 12: where it stands
intro: Where the accounts screen stands before its review, then one choice.

blocks.text:
## What changed
The accounts list now has **tabs per provider**, and a long name no longer pushes the tags off the row.

- The narrow screen still clips the tags on the Projects row.
- `wf screens --deep` passes on every other screen.
